title: WIKI: Add Docker Compose volume guide for auto-updating site-config (DRAFT included)
summary: **Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.** Yes. I run Wallabag via Docker. When websites change their HTML structure (e.g., taz.de), article parsing breaks (missing images, ads included). The community quickly updates the rules in the `j0k3r/graby-site-config` repository, but Docker users are often stuck with outdated configs until a new Wallabag release/image is built. It is frustrating to manually patch these `.txt` files every time a site's layout changes. **Describe the solution you'd like** Since the Wiki is restricted for external contributors, I would like to propose adding a new section to the existing Wiki page: [[Auto-Updating wallabag's site-depended config]](https://github.com/wallabag/wallabag/wiki/Auto%E2%80%90Updating-wallabag's-site%E2%80%90depended-config). The new section should provide a step-by-step guide for Docker Compose users on how to: 1. Mount the `/var/www/wallabag/vendor/j0k3r/graby-site-config` directory to a host volume. 2. Clone the `graby-site-config` Git repository into that host volume. 3. Set up a simple cronjob on the host (`git pull` + `docker exec wallabag php bin/console cache:clear`) to keep site configs automatically up to date without modifying the container itself. **Describe alternatives you've considered** * Manually downloading the fixed `.txt` file via `curl` into a custom volume whenever an article fails to parse (very tedious and reactive). * Waiting for official Wallabag Docker image updates to get the latest `graby` package (takes too long for daily reading workflows). **Additional context** I have already written the complete Markdown guide for this Docker-specific setup. Since I don't have edit rights for the Wiki, I will paste the Markdown text in a comment below so a maintainer can easily review and copy & paste it into the Wiki. --- [wallabag_docker_site_config_auto_update_guide.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/33262507/wallabag_docker_site_config_auto_update_guide.
